rules.message: L2 readiness: proposal.md is missing or empty
rules.fix_hint: 创建 .cowork-flow/changes/<slug>/proposal.md 并填写目标、用户价值、范围边界
rules.source_excerpt: L2 任务需要包含 proposal.md / spec.md / design.md

rules.message: L2 readiness: spec.md is missing or empty
rules.fix_hint: 创建 .cowork-flow/changes/<slug>/spec.md 并填写功能规格
rules.source_excerpt: L2 任务需要包含 proposal.md / spec.md / design.md

rules.message: L2 readiness: design.md is missing or empty
rules.fix_hint: 创建 .cowork-flow/changes/<slug>/design.md 并填写技术设计
rules.source_excerpt: L2 任务需要包含 proposal.md / spec.md / design.md

rules.condition: L2 任务必须有 plan 链接
rules.message: L2 readiness: change.yaml 缺少 plan 字段或链接无效
rules.fix_hint: 在 change.yaml 中添加 plan: .cowork-flow/plans/<date>-<slug>.md
rules.source_excerpt: L2 任务必须链接到实现计划

rules.condition: L2 任务必须有 task 链接
rules.message: L2 readiness: change.yaml 缺少 task 字段或链接无效
rules.fix_hint: 在 change.yaml 中添加 task: <task-dir> 关联到任务目录
rules.source_excerpt: L2 任务必须关联到任务目录

rules.condition: 行为变化场景应有失败测试
rules.message: Implementation without failing test for behavior change (workType=behavior_change/bugfix)
rules.fix_hint: 先在 quality.json 的 testPlan 中记录失败命令和预期，变绿后再完成

rules.condition: 完成前必须通过 review 阶段的质量门禁
rules.message: Task completion attempted without proper review/check phase evidence
rules.fix_hint: 先运行 ./.cowork-flow/run task review 进入 review 阶段，完成检查后再 complete
rules.source_excerpt: review 阶段需要 check 入口和验证命令

rules.condition: 任务目录必须包含 prd.md 和至少一个 jsonl 上下文文件
rules.message: Task directory missing prd.md or all required jsonl context files
rules.fix_hint: 运行 ./.cowork-flow/run task init-context <dir> 自动生成上下文骨架

rules.condition: L0 任务不应有链接的 change.yaml
rules.message: L0 task has a linked change.yaml — verify no user-observable behavior change
rules.fix_hint: 如果确实有用户可观察行为变化，使用 --level L1 或 --level L2 重建任务
rules.source_excerpt: L0 任务不改变用户可观察行为

rules.condition: 子代理不派发其他代理
rules.message: Subagent attempted to dispatch another agent — fixed agents are leaf executors
rules.fix_hint: 子代理只能执行实现/检查/研究，不能 spawn/wait/list/cancel 其他代理
rules.source_excerpt: Fixed agents cowork-research/implement/check are leaf executors

rules.condition: 子代理不修改规格文件
rules.fix_hint: 规格文件只能由主会话修改，子代理应通过研究提出建议而非直接修改
rules.source_excerpt: Subagents cannot modify spec, task status, or Git directly

rules.fix_hint: Git 操作只能由主会话执行
rules.source_excerpt: Subagents cannot modify spec, task status, or Git directly

rules.condition: 子代理不提交或归档任务
rules.message: Subagent attempted to commit or archive a task
rules.fix_hint: 提交和归档只能由主会话执行
rules.source_excerpt: Subagents cannot modify spec, task status, or Git directly

rules.condition: 不为一次性代码做抽象
rules.fix_hint: 保持代码简单直接，只有在确认需要复用时才进行抽象（参考 YAGNI）
rules.source_excerpt: 不为一次性代码提前做抽象

rules.message: Unrequested feature or scope expansion detected in implementation
rules.fix_hint: 只实现 PRD 中明确要求的功能，不扩大范围
rules.source_excerpt: 不添加用户没有要求的功能
